claims: Amy Madigan won the 2026 Best Supporting Actress Oscar for her role as Aunt Gladys in the horror film Weapons.
Amy Madigan's win marked her first Academy Award win.
Amy Madigan was honored at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
Amy Madigan set a record for the longest gap (40 years) between a first nomination and a win.
Elle Fanning and Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas were other nominees for Sentimental Value.
Wunmi Mosaku was an other nominee for Sinners.
Teyana Taylor was an other nominee for One Battle After Another.
Amy Madigan is the first actor to win an Oscar for a horror performance since Natalie Portman in 2011.
Madigan secured the win after successful performances at the Critics Choice and Actor Awards.
Amy Madigan thanked her husband, actor Ed Harris, during her speech.
